title: PROD: MC (Mitsuba) - Cascadia
description: Mitsuba motor controller: speed, battery power, temperatures, driver inputs and error flags (Mitsuba_Frame0/1/2).

panels.title: MC: Fault banner
panels.description: Red: a Mitsuba_Frame2 error bit is set now (names listed). Orange: MC link lost (no Frame0 in 3 s), overheat level > 0, or FET temperature ≥ 80 °C. Blank when everything is normal.

targets.query:
import "array"
import "strings"
label = (f) =>
    if f == "AnalogSensorError" then "Analog (AD) sensor"
    else if f == "MotorCurrentSensorUError" then "Motor current sensor U"
    else if f == "MotorCurrentSensorWError" then "Motor current sensor W"
    else if f == "FETThermistorError" then "FET thermistor"
    else if f == "BatteryVoltageSensorError" then "Battery voltage sensor"
    else if f == "BatteryCurrentSensorError" then "Battery current sensor"
    else if f == "BatteryCurrentSensorAdjustError" then "Battery current sensor zero"
    else if f == "MotorCurrentSensorAdjustError" then "Motor current sensor zero"
    else if f == "AcceleratorPositionError" then "Accelerator position"
    else if f == "ControllerVoltageSensorError" then "12 V line sensor"
    else if f == "PowerSystemError" then "Power system"
    else if f == "OverCurrentError" then "Over current"
    else if f == "OverVoltageError" then "Over voltage"
    else if f == "OverCurrentLimit" then "Over current limit"
    else if f == "MotorSystemError" then "Motor system"
    else if f == "MotorLock" then "Motor locked"
    else if f == "HallSensorShort" then "Hall sensor short"
    else if f == "HallSensorOpen" then "Hall sensor open"
    else f
st = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "MC")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "Mitsuba_Frame2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "AnalogSensorError" or r["_field"] == "MotorCurrentSensorUError" or r["_field"] == "MotorCurrentSensorWError" or r["_field"] == "FETThermistorError" or r["_field"] == "BatteryVoltageSensorError" or r["_field"] == "BatteryCurrentSensorError" or r["_field"] == "BatteryCurrentSensorAdjustError" or r["_field"] == "MotorCurrentSensorAdjustError" or r["_field"] == "AcceleratorPositionError" or r["_field"] == "ControllerVoltageSensorError" or r["_field"] == "PowerSystemError" or r["_field"] == "OverCurrentError" or r["_field"] == "OverVoltageError" or r["_field"] == "OverCurrentLimit" or r["_field"] == "MotorSystemError" or r["_field"] == "MotorLock" or r["_field"] == "HallSensorShort" or r["_field"] == "HallSensorOpen")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> toInt()
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "now")
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: r._field, _value: if r.now > 0 then 2 else if r._value > 0 then 1 else 0}))
  |> last()
  |> group()
act = st |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 2) |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: label(f: r._field)})) |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_field")
oh = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "MC" and r["class"] == "Mitsuba_Frame2" and r["_field"] == "OverHeatLevel")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value > 0 then "Overheat level " + string(v: int(v: r._value)) else ""}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
wl = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "MC" and r["class"] == "Mitsuba_Frame0" and r["_field"] == "BatteryVoltage")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0 > 3.0 then "MC link lost" else ""}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
wt = from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "MC" and r["class"] == "Mitsuba_Frame0" and r["_field"] == "FETTemperature")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value >= 80 then "FET temperature: " + string(v: int(v: r._value)) + " °C" else ""}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
warn = union(tables: [oh, wl, wt]) |> group() |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != "") |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
f = if length(arr: act) > 0 then "ACTIVE FAULT: " + strings.joinStr(arr: act, v: ", ") else ""
w = if length(arr: warn) > 0 then "WARNING: " + strings.joinStr(arr: warn, v: ", ") else ""
msg = if f != "" and w != "" then f + "   |   " + w else f + w
array.from(rows: [{_value: msg}]) |> yield(name: "banner")

panels.title: Link (s since last frame)
panels.description: Time since the last Mitsuba_Frame0 reached InfluxDB (looks back 1 h). Red after 3 s: MC, the DRD data request, CAN or the radio link is down.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "MC")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "Mitsuba_Frame0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "BatteryVoltage")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: "Last frame", _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> yield(name: "age")

from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "MC")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "Mitsuba_Frame0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "MotorRotatingSpeed")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "last")

panels.title: Battery current
panels.description: Signed: positive = drawing from the pack, negative = regen into the pack (BatteryCurrentDirection = 1).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "CAN_prod")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "MC")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["class"] == "Mitsuba_Frame0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "BatteryCurrent" or r["_field"] == "BatteryCurrentDirection")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.BatteryCurrent and exists r.BatteryCurrentDirection)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Battery current", _value: if float(v: r.BatteryCurrentDirection) == 1.0 then -float(v: r.BatteryCurrent) else float(v: r.BatteryCurrent)}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "signed")

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "AnalogSensorError" or r["_field"] == "MotorCurrentSensorUError" or r["_field"] == "MotorCurrentSensorWError" or r["_field"] == "FETThermistorError" or r["_field"] == "BatteryVoltageSensorError" or r["_field"] == "BatteryCurrentSensorError" or r["_field"] == "BatteryCurrentSensorAdjustError" or r["_field"] == "MotorCurrentSensorAdjustError" or r["_field"] == "AcceleratorPositionError" or r["_field"] == "ControllerVoltageSensorError" or r["_field"] == "PowerSystemError" or r["_field"] == "OverCurrentError" or r["_field"] == "OverVoltageError" or r["_field"] == "OverCurrentLimit" or r["_field"] == "MotorSystemError" or r["_field"] == "MotorLock" or r["_field"] == "HallSensorShort" or r["_field"] == "HallSensorOpen")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> toInt()

  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["_value"])
